description: A collection of helper functions for testing Kubernetes components, including resource cleanup, assertions, and version checks.

methods.name: kube::test::clear_all
methods.description: Deletes all resource types 'rc' and 'pods' if supported.

methods.name: kube::test::get_caller
methods.description: Prints the filename and line number of the caller at specified depth.

methods.name: kube::test::get_object_assert
methods.description: Runs kubectl get with a go-template and asserts the output matches expected.

methods.name: kube::test::wait_object_assert
methods.description: Repeatedly runs get assertions until success or max attempts reached.

methods.name: kube::test::object_assert
methods.description: Runs kubectl get with a go-template multiple times, asserting match.

methods.name: kube::test::get_object_jsonpath_assert
methods.description: Asserts that kubectl get with jsonpath matches expected.

methods.name: kube::test::describe_object_assert
methods.description: Describes a resource and asserts specific strings are present.

methods.name: kube::test::describe_object_events_assert
methods.description: Describes a resource and checks for events presence based on showevents flag.

methods.name: kube::test::describe_resource_assert
methods.description: Describes a resource and asserts specific strings are present.

methods.name: kube::test::describe_resource_events_assert
methods.description: Describes a resource with event info and checks for events presence.

methods.name: kube::test::describe_resource_chunk_size_assert
methods.description: Checks that resource describe requests include limit parameters for chunking.

methods.name: kube::test::if_sort_by_has_correct_order
methods.description: Verifies sorted order of resource list output.

methods.name: kube::test::if_has_string
methods.description: Checks if a message contains a specific string.

methods.name: kube::test::if_has_not_string
methods.description: Checks if a message does not contain a specific string.

methods.name: kube::test::if_empty_string
methods.description: Verifies that a string is empty.

methods.name: kube::test::if_supports_resource
methods.description: Checks if a resource type is supported by the API server.

methods.name: kube::test::version::object_to_file
methods.description: Extracts version info for a component and writes to file.

methods.name: kube::test::version::json_object_to_file
methods.description: Extracts version info in JSON format and writes to file.

methods.name: kube::test::version::json_client_server_object_to_file
methods.description: Extracts client/server version info in JSON and writes to file.

methods.name: kube::test::version::yaml_object_to_file
methods.description: Extracts version info in YAML format and writes to file.

methods.name: kube::test::version::diff_assert
methods.description: Compares two files with optional sorting and reports differences.

methods.name: kube::test::results::diff
methods.description: Compares actual and expected stdout, stderr, and return code for test validation.
